requiredScenarios.expectation: A second submit with the same taskId and requestDigest returns 202 with replayed=true and creates no second task.
A second submit with the same taskId and a different requestDigest returns 409 TASK_DIGEST_CONFLICT.
Last-Event-ID N returns only persisted events with sequence greater than N, in contiguous order.
The same clientRequestId and requestDigest returns the existing execution and never dispatches a second broker effect.
The same clientRequestId with a different requestDigest returns 409 and preserves the first execution.
After Engine restart, the persisted Receipt is reused and the task reaches one terminal state without another sandbox dispatch.
Repeated cancellation converges on one cancelled terminal event; cancellation after another terminal state does not rewrite it.
The same questionId and answerDigest is accepted as a replay and consumes the pending question exactly once.
The same questionId with a different answerDigest returns 409 QUESTION_ANSWER_CONFLICT and preserves the first answer.
Every provider request consumes one of 20 model-call slots, maxOutputTokens is 4096, tools are serial, and recovery never resets the budget.
Sandbox status polls use 1, 2, 4, 5, 5... second delays without jitter and stop at timeoutMillis plus 30000 ms.
An idle live SSE stream emits a non-persisted comment heartbeat every 15000 ms without consuming a sequence.
Expired, wrong-task, wrong-permission and malformed task grants are rejected before Workspace or Sandbox access.
Events contain bounded summaries and refs but no source body, task grant, service credential, host path or unbounded process output.

Knowledge search derives the authenticated user and frozen Project from task authority, includes only active public/user/project-authorized knowledge, and never accepts identity or scope from the Engine.
The same taskId, operation, clientRequestId and requestDigest returns the persisted normalized result with replayed=true and performs no second retrieval.
The same taskId, operation and clientRequestId with changed canonical request content returns 409 TOOL_REQUEST_CONFLICT and preserves the first result.
Expired, wrong-task or missing knowledge.search/literature.search permission is rejected before any local or upstream retrieval.
An Engine cannot select a user or Project; a grant and persisted task authority mismatch fails closed before knowledge or literature access.
Queries, result counts, excerpts, abstracts, authors, metadata arrays and warnings are rejected or deterministically truncated to the schema limits before persistence.
Literature provider errors become stable warning or Problem codes and never expose raw exception text, credentials, provider request URLs or internal endpoints.

knowledge.search and literature.search events contain only bounded query/result-count summaries and an opaque searchRef; no excerpt, abstract, provider error or credential is persisted in task events.
